title: Forgetting Sarah Marshall
about: A TV composer gets dumped by his star girlfriend, flees to Hawaii, and finds her there with her new rock star boyfriend.

    StartersResort poke on rice crackersCubed tuna in soy and sesame oil with spring onion, on rice crackersHow to make it300g sashimi tuna2 tbsp soy sauce1 tsp sesame oil2 spring onions1 packet rice crackersCut the tuna into small cubes.Toss with soy sauce, sesame oil and sliced spring onion.Spoon onto rice crackers just before serving so they stay crisp.Kunu's grilled pineapplePineapple spears brushed with honey and lime, grilled until charredHow to make it1 pineapple3 tbsp honey2 limesCut the pineapple into long spears.Brush with honey mixed with lime juice.Grill over high heat, turning, until caramelised and charred at the edges.Serve warm with extra lime.Dracula's Taste for Love beetroot dipPeter's Dracula puppet musicalHow to make itAs written, serves 4Roast beetroot blitzed blood red with feta, garlic, walnuts and lemon, served with oven-baked pita crisps dusted in smoked paprika.Wrap 3 medium beetroot in foil and roast at 200°C for 50 minutes until tender, then peel.Blitz with 100g feta, 1 garlic clove, 40g walnuts, the juice of 1 lemon and 3 tbsp olive oil until smooth and season.Cut 4 pita breads into wedges, brush with oil, sprinkle with smoked paprika and salt and bake at 180°C for 10 minutes until crisp.Serve the dip with crumbled feta on top.North Shore garlic prawnsDo less, says Chuck. Just eat.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsLuau kalua porkPork shoulder slow cooked in banana leaves with smoked salt, over jasmine riceHow to make it2kg pork shoulder2 tbsp smoked salt4 banana leaves300g jasmine rice, uncooked1 small cabbage2 tbsp lime juice1 tbsp sesame oilRub the pork with smoked salt.Wrap tightly in banana leaves, then foil.Cook at 150°C until it falls apart.While the pork rests, cook the jasmine rice and shred the cabbage with lime juice and sesame oil.Shred the pork and serve over rice with the cabbage salad.Resort fish tacos with mango salsaLunch by the pool at the resortHow to make itAs written, serves 4White fish dusted in chilli and cumin, pan-fried, tucked into warm corn tortillas with mango salsa, lime and coriander.Cut 600g firm white fish fillets into strips and toss with 1 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin, salt and oil.Dice 1 mango, half a red onion and 1 red chilli and mix with coriander and the juice of 1 lime.Pan-fry the fish over high heat for 2 minutes a side until just cooked.Mix 120g sour cream with lime zest.Warm 12 small corn tortillas and fill with shredded cabbage, fish, salsa and lime crema.SweetsDracula puppet mango lime sorbetFrozen mango and lime ice, scraped with a forkHow to make it150g caster sugar150ml hot water3 ripe mangoes2 limesDissolve the sugar in the hot water and cool.Blend the mango flesh with the syrup and lime juice until smooth.Freeze in a tray, scraping with a fork every hour.Scoop into glasses.DrinksDark rum mai taiDark rum, orange juice, lime and sugar syrup over crushed iceHow to make it180ml dark rum240ml orange juice80ml lime juice (about 3 limes)60ml sugar syrup (from caster sugar and water)4 sprigs of mint2 cups crushed iceMake the sugar syrup by dissolving equal parts caster sugar and hot water, then cool.Shake the rum, juices and syrup over ice, one drink at a time.Strain over crushed ice and top with mint.
